'''Tim Green''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Pleasanton tournament (7 April)]] on 7 April 2001 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|SKUM drains]] and TRM new age, according to Kyle Ishimaru's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2051">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-09-pleasanton-ca-4-7-01d2051/ pleasanton-ca-4-7-01], DeckTech (Kyle "Psyokid" Ishimaru, 9 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-09-pleasanton-ca-4-7-01d2051/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
